plugin.name: Attio
plugin.description: Attio CRM: a webhook trigger and changed-since operations that output activity items, records with notes, workspace members, and note, task and list-entry creation over the REST API
plugin.author: Landflow

nodes.name: attioTrigger
nodes.description: Starts the workflow when a record, list entry (pipeline stage), note or task changes in Attio, with the change as an activity item (actor email, link, company and team hints)
nodes.subtitle: {{events}}

source.description: The tool, lowercase: slack, google-drive, google-calendar, notion, …

sourceId.description: Stable id of the change, '<source>:<tool ids>': the same change always has the same id, so a replay is recognised

actorEmail.description: Email of the person who made the change, lowercase; null when the tool doesn't say

occurredAt.description: When it happened, ISO 8601 in UTC with milliseconds

kind.description: Suggested event kind, such as work.discussion or work.doc_edited; a flow may change it

title.description: One line: the document, ticket or meeting title, or the channel and first words

summary.description: The text, whitespace collapsed, at most 600 characters

teamHint.description: The team it seems to belong to, from the tool's own grouping, when there is one

initiativeHint.description: The project or initiative it seems to belong to, when there is one

customerHint.description: The customer it is about, when there is one (a #customer-<name> channel, a CRM company…)

raw.description: The tool's own object, trimmed: long strings clipped, long lists cut, deep nesting dropped

cursor.description: Pass it back as Since to continue after this item (List Changed Since operations)

options.name: Access Token
options.description: A workspace access token (API key) pasted from Attio

properties.name: notice
properties.displayName: Publishing registers a webhook in Attio for this node (the token needs webhook:read-write and a workspace-level token). Attio only accepts an HTTPS public URL. Attio shows the webhook secret once, so Landflow keeps it for the signature check; unpublishing removes the webhook.

properties.name: events

options.name: Record Updated
options.description: A value of the record changed (a deal moved stage)

options.name: List Entry Created
options.description: A record was added to a list (a deal to a pipeline)

options.name: List Entry Updated
options.description: A value of a list entry changed (a pipeline stage moved)

properties.description: The Attio events that start a run

properties.name: objects
properties.description: Records, list entries and notes of these objects (API slugs, comma-separated) start a run. Empty: every object. Tasks are not tied to an object and always pass.

values.name: wonStages
values.description: Comma-separated stage names that count as won (compared ignoring case, emoji and punctuation, so "Won 🎉" matches Won): the kind becomes work.deal_won

values.name: stageAttribute
values.description: The API slug of the status attribute that holds the stage (deals: stage; a list: the list's own status attribute)

values.name: teamHint
values.description: A constant for teamHint on every item. Empty: no team hint.

nodes.name: attio
nodes.description: Read Attio records and pipeline entries as activity items (get one, or list what changed since a time), list workspace members, and create notes, tasks and list entries

properties.name: object
properties.description: The object's API slug (companies, people, deals or a custom object) or ID

properties.name: recordId
properties.description: The record's UUID

properties.name: list
properties.description: The list's API slug or ID, such as a sales pipeline

properties.name: list
properties.description: The list's API slug or ID to add the record to

properties.name: since
properties.description: Rows changed after this ISO time or the cursor of an earlier item. Empty: the last 24 hours.

properties.name: since
properties.description: Rows changed after this ISO time or the cursor of an earlier item. Empty: the last 24 hours.

properties.name: detect
properties.description: Attio has no updated-at timestamp on records and entries, so this picks how a change is found

options.name: Any Value Changed (Reads Every Row)
options.description: Reads all rows and takes the newest time any value was set. Complete, but one call per 200 rows.

options.name: Stage Changed (Server Filter)
options.description: Only rows whose stage (the Stage Attribute) changed since: a deal moved. One filtered query.

options.name: Created (Server Filter)
options.description: Only rows created since. Cheapest; misses edits of older rows.

properties.name: returnAll
properties.description: Whether to return all results or only up to a limit

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Max number of results to return (the oldest first; pass the last cursor back as Since for the next batch)

values.name: wonStages
values.description: Comma-separated stage names that count as won (compared ignoring case, emoji and punctuation, so "Won 🎉" matches Won): the kind becomes work.deal_won

values.name: stageAttribute
values.description: The API slug of the status attribute that holds the stage (deals: stage; a list: the list's own status attribute)

values.name: teamHint
values.description: A constant for teamHint on every item. Empty: no team hint.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The note's title (plain text)

properties.name: content
properties.description: The note's text

properties.name: taskContent
properties.description: What to do (plain text, up to 2000 characters)

properties.name: deadline
properties.description: ISO time the task is due. Empty: no deadline.

properties.name: linkedObject
properties.description: The object of the record to link (with Linked Record ID). Empty: no link.

properties.name: assignees
properties.description: Workspace members to assign, by email (comma-separated)

properties.name: entryValues
properties.description: Attribute values of the new entry, keyed by API slug, e.g. {"stage": "Lead"}. Empty: none.

credentialTypes.name: attioApi
credentialTypes.description: A workspace access token (API key) made under Settings, Developers in Attio, with the scopes the nodes need (see the plugin README).

properties.name: accessToken
properties.description: The workspace access token, sent as a Bearer token

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Change it only for a proxy or a test double

credentialTypes.name: attioOAuth2Api
credentialTypes.description: Sign in with Attio: create an app at build.attio.com, add the redirect URL shown below on its OAuth tab, enable the scopes on its Scopes tab (read for records, lists, notes, tasks and members; write for the Note, Task and Add to List actions; webhook:read-write for the trigger), then Connect. Attio sends no refresh token, the access token does not expire.

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Change it only for a proxy or a test double
